brief: Two bins to sort my dead AA batteries for recycling.

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full + bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full in adjacent full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full); check_build ok, meshClash clear. No AA-battery prop exists in find_props (battery/AA searches empty), so bins left empty for user's own batteries.
requirements.requirement: Two bins to sort dead AA batteries for recycling

finish.summary: Two adjacent full-depth bins on a 2-cell base, capped and locked. No battery props exist so bins are empty and ready for dead AAs.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
